newsitem.title: USA: GulfWest Oil acquires 279 W.Texas wells.
newsitem.headline: GulfWest Oil acquires 279 W.Texas wells.

text.p: GulfWest Oil Co said Tuesday it has acquired a 100 percent working interest in 279 oil wells on 5,100 acres in the Vaughn Field, Crockett County, Texas, for $3.1 million in cash.
Currently, 82 of the wells are active, producing an aggregate of 235 barrels of oil per day.

The company said it plans to place 80 of the inactive wells back in production over the next six months through enhancement and recompletions, increasing production to some 420 barrels per day. The field has numerous infield drilling locations as well as secondary recovery potential.
It said the properties have proved developed oil reserves of 1.3 million barrels. "This acquisition doubles our total proved reserves to 2.9 million barrels of oil equivalent."
